Buying Types of  Networking Component in Bangladesh

\n

Wi-Fi Broadband Router (TP-Link, ASUS, Netgear, Linksys, D-Link, Xiaomi, Huawei)

\nA Wi-Fi Broadband Router from brands like TP-Link, ASUS, Netgear, Linksys, D-Link, Xiaomi, and Huawei provides reliable wireless connectivity for homes and offices. These routers offer various features such as dual-band support, high-speed data transmission, and wide coverage to handle multiple devices efficiently. \n

Ethernet Router (Cisco, Linksys, MikroTik, Ubiquiti, D-Link, DrayTek, TP-Link)

\nEthernet Routers from Cisco, Linksys, MikroTik, Ubiquiti, D-Link, DrayTek, and TP-Link are known for their robust performance in professional environments. These routers ensure reliable wired connections, perfect for businesses or setups that demand stability and fast speeds. \n

Wi-Fi Access Point / Range Extender (Ubiquiti, TP-Link, D-Link, ASUS, Netgear, Cisco, Zyxel)

\nBrands like Ubiquiti, TP-Link, D-Link, ASUS, Netgear, Cisco, and Zyxel offer Wi-Fi Access Points and Range Extenders that are perfect for expanding network coverage. Ubiquiti’s UniFi series is well-known for larger spaces, while TP-Link and Netgear provide reliable options for home environments. \n

Switch (Cisco, Netgear, TP-Link, D-Link, Juniper Networks, HPE Aruba, Zyxel)

\nNetwork Switches from brands like Cisco, Netgear, TP-Link, D-Link, Juniper Networks, HPE Aruba, and Zyxel offer robust and scalable networking solutions. Cisco is a leader in enterprise-grade solutions, while Netgear and TP-Link cater to small and medium-sized businesses. \n

Wi-Fi Receiver / Adapter (TP-Link, ASUS, Netgear, D-Link, Alfa Network, Edimax)

\nWi-Fi Receivers/Adapters from TP-Link, ASUS, Netgear, D-Link, Alfa Network, and Edimax enable older desktops or laptops to connect to wireless networks. These devices are often plug-and-play, providing a quick and easy solution for upgrading devices to support Wi-Fi. \n

MikroTik Products (MikroTik)

\nMikroTik offers a range of professional networking equipment such as RouterBOARD and Cloud Core Routers, making it a popular choice for ISPs, businesses, and enterprises. Their products provide advanced features like routing, switching, and wireless connectivity, all at an affordable price. \n

FTTx (Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, FiberHome, Cisco, Adtran)

\nFTTx solutions from Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, FiberHome, Cisco, and Adtran deliver high-speed fiber optic internet to homes, businesses, and data centers. These brands are instrumental in building next-generation fiber infrastructures worldwide, providing blazing-fast connectivity. \n

Media Converter (TP-Link, D-Link, TRENDnet, Allied Telesis, Perle Systems)

\nMedia Converters from brands like TP-Link, D-Link, TRENDnet, Allied Telesis, and Perle Systems enable seamless integration between different types of network media. These converters are essential when integrating fiber networks with copper-based Ethernet systems. \n

Firewall (Fortinet, Cisco, Sophos, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, SonicWall)

\nFirewalls from Fortinet, Cisco, Sophos, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, and SonicWall provide comprehensive protection for businesses and home networks. These solutions are designed to guard against cyber threats, malware, and unauthorized access. \n

Network Ethernet Card / LAN Card (Intel, TP-Link, Realtek, ASUS, Broadcom)

\nNetworking Component like Network Ethernet Cards from Intel, TP-Link, Realtek, ASUS, and Broadcom ensure reliable and fast wired connectivity for computers and servers. Intel and Broadcom are trusted for enterprise-grade performance, while TP-Link and Realtek cater to home and small office needs. \n

PoE Injector (Ubiquiti, TP-Link, TRENDnet, Cisco, D-Link, MikroTik)

\nNetworking Component like PoE (Power over Ethernet) Injectors from Ubiquiti, TP-Link, TRENDnet, Cisco, D-Link, and MikroTik allow both power and data to be sent over a single Ethernet cable. This is especially useful for powering devices like wireless access points, IP cameras, and VoIP phones in areas without access to electrical outlets.

children.name: Wi-Fi Router
children.description:
Best Wi-Fi Router Price in Bangladesh

\nBest Wi-Fi Router Price in Bangladesh starts from BDT 950 to BDT 230,000 depending on features and brands. \n \nA router is a crucial networking device that sends and receives data across various computer networks. Unlike modems or network hubs, routers combine the functionalities of these devices to connect multiple gadgets seamlessly. By directing internet traffic, a router allows multiple devices to share the same internet connection efficiently. \n \nIn today’s connected world, routers are essential for homes, businesses, and institutions. Best Computer Hub Ltd, a leading tech retail brand in Bangladesh, offers a wide range of Wi-Fi, dual-band, and wired routers at competitive prices. \n

Popular Brands of Routers in Bangladesh

\nwifi router price in bd - Routers manage data packets, directing traffic from one router to another until it reaches its destination. At Best Computer Hub, you can find high-quality wired and wireless routers from top brands like Tenda, TP-Link, Totolink, Mikrotik, Wavlink, D-Link, HUAWEI, Mi, Cisco, Netgear, Mercusys, and Netis, all available at convenient prices. \n

Key Features to Consider When Buying a Router

\nWi-Fi Frequency and Transmission: Most routers operate on the 2.4 GHz band, while some offer 5 GHz bands. Dual-band routers support both frequencies, ideal for varied uses. Typical routers transmit up to 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz, while gaming routers can reach up to 1000 Mbps. The latest Wi-Fi 7 routers offer speeds up to 320 MHz or 6 GHz. \n \nAntenna Type: Routers feature either omnidirectional or directional antennas. Omnidirectional antennas provide broad coverage with a round radiation pattern, ideal for general indoor and outdoor use. Directional antennas focus the signal in one direction, offering limited but stronger coverage. \n \nConnectivity: Modern routers often support wireless connectivity (Wi-Fi 7), allowing devices to connect wirelessly within a broad range, making them suitable for homes and offices. \n \nEthernet Ports: Ethernet ports connect devices directly to the internet. Many routers offer Gigabit Ethernet for high-speed wired connections. Typically, routers come with 1 WAN port and 2-4 LAN ports. \n

Varieties of Routers

\nWireless Routers: Manage internet traffic wirelessly within offices, homes, or public areas. They convert wired broadband data into radio signals. \n \nWired Routers: Connect devices in a local area network (LAN) through wired connections, often featuring built-in firewalls. \n \nOutdoor Routers: Extend Wi-Fi networks over long distances, ideal for large or remote areas. \n \nGigabit Routers: Offer high-speed data transmission up to 1000 Mbps, suitable for extensive coverage areas. \n \nPocket Routers: Portable router with SIM slots and power banks, perfect for on-the-go connectivity. \n \nMesh Routers: Create a seamless network over large areas by linking multiple Wi-Fi networks. \n \nTri-band and Dual-band Routers: Offer multiple frequency bands for improved bandwidth and speed. \n

Uses and Benefits of Routers

\nRegular Users: Basic wifi router with 300 Mbps speed are sufficient for personal use. \n \nGamers: High-speed routers (above 1000 Mbps) with advanced features enhance the gaming experience. \n \nOffices: Business-class routers from brands like Cisco and Ubiquiti offer advanced features and support. \n \nTraveling: Portable routers provide remote Wi-Fi access and often come with SIM slots. \n

Choosing the Right Router in Bangladesh

\nWi-Fi Coverage: Ensure the router covers the required area, from 100 feet indoors to 5000 sq. ft. with mesh routers. \n \nSpeed: Choose based on your needs—standard speeds for regular use, higher speeds for gaming. \n \nBudget: Align your budget with the router's features to find the best option. \n

Pocket Router Price in BD

\nA pocket router is a compact and portable device that allows users to access the internet on the go. Ideal for travelers, students, or remote workers, it provides Wi-Fi connectivity using a SIM card or existing network. With easy setup and battery-powered operation, pocket routers are convenient for mobile internet needs. The pocket router price in BD varies depending on the brand and features, typically ranging from ৳1,500 to ৳3,500. Popular models from TP-Link, Huawei, and other brands offer reliable performance. Whether for personal or business use, a pocket router is a smart solution for wireless connectivity anytime, anywhere. \n

Difference Between Router and Modem

\nA router creates a LAN network, enabling internet access for multiple devices. Some routers connect internal networks to external networks (internet). A modem, however, connects directly to the internet using a WAN network via a public IP address. \n \nFor the best selection and router price in bd, visit Best Computer Hub Ltd, the leading electronics retailer. Upgrade your home or office network with high-quality routers your needs.

\nWiFI Access Point/Range Extender price in Bangladesh | An access point, also known as a wireless access point (WAP), range extender, or AP, connects directly to a wired local area network (usually Ethernet), allowing Wi-Fi devices to connect seamlessly to the network. In most cases, it connects to a router, either as a standalone device or as part of an access point router. Access points expand the network, enabling multiple wireless devices to stay connected efficiently. \n

\nWhile routers send data packets to their destination, access points primarily allow wireless devices to connect using antennas. Today's routers are multifunctional, offering features like routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, and built-in access points. What are FTTX Products?

\nFTTX stands for Fiber to the X, where the "X" represents different network configurations like FTTH (Fiber to the Home), FTTB (Fiber to the Building), and FTTC (Fiber to the Curb).     • \n \t
  • ONT (Optical Network Terminals): These devices convert fiber optic signals to Ethernet signals and allow devices to connect to the internet.
    • \n \t
  • Fiber Splitters: These devices are used to split optical signals from a single fiber to multiple users or locations.
    • \n \t
  • Fiber Patch Cords: These cords are used for connecting devices to the fiber network and are crucial for establishing a stable connection.
